name: Emphasis (tawkīd)
definition: A follower that confirms the word before it with set words (nafs, ʿayn, kull, ajmaʿ), agreeing with it in iʿrāb and definiteness.
body: Qāma zaydun nafsuhu: Zayd himself stood, not someone sent by him. Raʾaytu al-qawma kullahum: I saw the people, all of them, not only some.

Al-Ājurrūmiyya teaches the 'meaning' kind with these words (al-nafs, al-ʿayn, kull, ajmaʿ and its followers aktaʿ, abtaʿ, abṣaʿ); repeating the word itself is the 'verbal' kind, taught in the longer books.

examples.text: I saw the people, all of them (al-Ājurrūmiyya).
